title: Priya's birthday
explanation: The options gave a choice, the criteria turned the ideas into a comparison, and the pick gave one reason tied to cost and effort. One answer is a guess. Three answers with criteria let you choose.
ticket: Three different ideas for Priya's 10th birthday party, compared on cost and effort, with one recommendation and one reason.
promptTemplate: Give me an idea for Priya's 10th birthday party.{options}{criteria}{pick}

ingredients.label: The options
ingredients.text: Give me three different ideas: a cheap one, an active one, and a creative one.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants three different ideas to choose from. Your order asks for only one.

ingredients.label: The criteria
ingredients.text: Compare them on cost and on effort for me, each low, medium, or high.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants to compare. Your order never says what to compare them on.

ingredients.label: The pick
ingredients.text: Recommend one and give one reason.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants a recommendation. Your order never asks for one.

outputs.base: How about a backyard movie night? Hang a sheet as a screen, lay out blankets and cushions, and serve popcorn. It is easy, and kids love it.
outputs.options:
Here are three ideas:
1. A picnic in the park (cheap)
2. A garden obstacle course (active)
3. A make-your-own pizza party (creative)
outputs.criteria: A backyard movie night has a low cost and a low effort. You only need a sheet, a screen or projector, and some snacks.
outputs.pick: I recommend a backyard movie night, because it is fun for everyone.
outputs.criteria+options:
1. A picnic in the park: cost low, effort low
2. A garden obstacle course: cost low, effort medium
3. A make-your-own pizza party: cost medium, effort high
outputs.options+pick: Ideas: a picnic, a garden obstacle course, and a make-your-own pizza party. I recommend the pizza party because it sounds the most fun.
outputs.criteria+pick: A backyard movie night: cost low, effort low. I recommend it because it is simple.
outputs.criteria+options+pick:
1. A picnic in the park: cost low, effort low
2. A garden obstacle course: cost low, effort medium
3. A make-your-own pizza party: cost medium, effort high
I recommend the picnic. It costs and takes the least, and it still feels like a party.
